title: Clear signup errors while correcting fields
steps: Inspect the signup form with email alex and revealed password short, each displaying a red validation message.
Click Email Address and append @example.com, leaving the corrected email focused.
Click Password to move focus away from Email Address.
Select the password text and type Kestrel!482, leaving Password focused; inspect the form.

video_guide.summary: Watch the password correction and compare the entered value with its minimum-length validation message.

chapters.note: Email Address already contains alex@example.com. Password contains short and has a minimum-eight-character error below it.

chapters.label: Replace short in Password with Kestrel!482

chapters.note: Password contains Kestrel!482, but its border is red and the minimum-eight-character message is still visible.
Password still contains Kestrel!482 with a red border and the minimum-eight-character error below it.
